newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $20 a tonne higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $20 a tonne higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $20 a tonne higher on Wednesday, after a strong performance in London overnight, traders said.

London cocoa futures rose sharply early Wednesday, but prices stayed within the recent 980-1,065 stg range basis July. At the midday break, LIFFE July cocoa was up 16 stg, to 1,005 stg, while September rose 18 stg, to 1,023 stg.

Tuesday, New York cocoa futures ended broadly higher, boosted by currency-related buying. July futures rose $24 a tonne, to finish at $1,409, after ranging from $1,418 to $1,385. Spot May ended $25 higher, at $1,399, while the back months gained $24 to $27.
Technically, traders said July was likely to run into resistance at $1,428. Support was seen at $1,400, followed by today's low of $1,385.
